name: publica-now-wordpress
description: Development environment for the Publica.now WordPress plugin. The plugin has no JavaScript build step; this package only provides wp-env and Plugin Check.

scripts.check:install: wp-env run cli wp plugin install plugin-check --force --activate
scripts.check: wp-env run cli wp plugin check publica-now --exclude-directories=vendor,node_modules,dist,.wordpress-org
scripts.check:repo: wp-env run cli wp plugin check publica-now --categories=plugin_repo --error-severity=7 --warning-severity=6 --include-low-severity-errors --exclude-directories=vendor,node_modules,dist,.wordpress-org --format=table
scripts.pot: wp-env run cli bash -c "php -d memory_limit=512M /usr/local/bin/wp i18n make-pot wp-content/plugins/publica-now wp-content/plugins/publica-now/languages/publica-now.pot --slug=publica-now --domain=publica-now --exclude=vendor,node_modules,dist,bin,docs,tests,.wordpress-org"
scripts.lint:js: for f in blocks/*/index.js; do [ -e "$f" ] && node --check "$f"; done
